description: Defines the EmployeeSkill entity class with ORM mappings, representing employee skills with properties for employee, skill, years of experience, and comments.

classes.name: EmployeeSkill
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's skill, including relations to Employee and Skill entities, with properties for years of experience and comments.

methods.name: getDecorator
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeSkillDecorator instance associated with this entity.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this skill record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this skill record.

methods.name: getSkill
methods.description: Returns the Skill associated with this record.

methods.name: setSkill
methods.description: Sets the Skill for this record.

methods.name: getYearsOfExp
methods.description: Returns the years of experience for this skill.

methods.name: setYearsOfExp
methods.description: Sets the years of experience for this skill.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns comments related to this skill.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets comments related to this skill.
